record.question: The term 'Ways and Means Advances (WMA)', sometimes seen in the news, refers to:
options: A mechanism by the Reserve Bank of India to provide short-term credit to governments to bridge temporary cash flow mismatches
A long-term fiscal deficit financing tool through issuance of treasury bonds
A special window for commercial banks to borrow funds to meet capital adequacy norms
A subsidy scheme launched by the Government of India to support state finances
